## Description

Estimates local trend strength across candidate horizons and assigns a label based on the best-fit forward trend, often used to create training labels.

## Where it may fit

Developing supervised trend classifiers or selecting holding horizons in markets with variable trend durations.

## Vehicles

Systematic equity, futures, FX and crypto strategies; ML research pipelines.

## Required data

Timestamped prices, candidate horizons, rolling regression/trend statistics and strictly forward outcome windows.

## Caveats

Labels are future-derived targets for training, never live features; use purging/embargo and realistic overlapping-trade accounting.
